title: 第25章 败叶兴龙震惊众人第26章 我与叶家再无瓜葛
content_zh:
看到苏尘如此嚣张的答应下来，叶兴龙立刻对叶震骁说道：“爷爷，苏尘如此无礼，若不教训他一下，还以为我叶家好欺负！”
叶震骁当即就答应了下来，生怕苏尘反悔。
他忌惮玄阳大师和柳擎，不敢以大欺小，但同辈切磋，那就另当别论了。
“兴龙！
这小子如此嚣狂，也不知有何依仗，你还需小心一些。”
叶德元虽然对儿子的实力很信赖，但刚才苏尘表现出来的气势实在太强横，让他感到有些心神不宁。
“大哥多虑了吧！
苏尘是出生大族，以前也是少年天骄，距离玄武境都只差一步，自幼便有诸多宝物淬炼洗礼肉身，力气大一点也很正常，但血脉天赋和丹田破损是不可逆的！”
叶德明说道。
“父亲放心！
他那点依仗根本不算什么，很快我就会让他知道，武者可不只是力气大就抗衡的！”
叶兴龙相当的自信，压根儿没被苏尘放在眼里。
不仅如此，他还要用这一战彻底为自己正名，彻底踩死苏尘，让他永世不得翻身！
叶家大院的广场上，宾客们很快退开，留出了一个巨大的空地。
众人的眼神中充满了期待的神色。
叶兴龙，觉醒地级血脉，天赋超绝，成功加入王都武道院，更被武道院长老看重，收为弟子！
苏尘，曾经拥有天级血脉的少年天骄，修为更曾达到真武境九层巅峰，虽然天赋和修为尽皆被废，但却表现出了惊人的强势，必有后手。
这两个在北荒城，都是充满了传奇色彩的人物。
嗖！
叶兴龙身形一闪，就出现在战台的中央。

“苏尘，你胆大包天污蔑爷爷和我叶家，今天我就好好教训教训你，让你知道废物就该唯唯诺诺的苟活，胆敢嚣张，只有死路一条！”
叶兴龙冷冷的说道，眼神中尽是狠毒之色。
“本事不怎么样，废话倒是不少！”
苏尘冷笑了一声道。
“你找死！”
叶兴龙顿时就被激怒了，眸子之中杀意弥漫。
轰！
他周身气息鼓荡，雄浑的真气如风暴般肆虐，一身气武境九层巅峰的修为爆发出来，让整个叶家大院中都吹起猛烈的罡风。
“嘶，气武境九层？叶兴龙今年才二十多岁吧？”
“确切的说，只有二十一岁！”
“二十一岁就达到气武境九层？这种修炼速度简直是惊世骇俗，看来今天苏尘输定了！”
众人都是惊呼了一声道。
偌大北荒城，就算是老一辈的武者，大都还在气武境徘徊，他老子叶德元也不过前不久刚突破真武境而已。
毫无疑问，叶兴龙的天赋，就算是放在天才云集的王都城，也是上等。
在他们看来，苏尘的力气再大，能匹敌气武境四五重的武者也是极限了，如何能与气武境九层巅峰的叶兴龙匹敌？
content_en:
Seeing Su Chen agreeing so arrogantly, Ye Xinglong immediately said to Ye Zhenxiao: "Grandpa, Su Chen is so rude. If you don't teach him a lesson, he will think that my Ye family is easy to bully!"
Ye Zhenxiao immediately agreed, fearing that Su Chen would regret it.
He was afraid of Master Xuanyang and Liu Qing and did not dare to bully the younger ones, but it was another matter to compete with peers.
"Xinglong!
This kid is so arrogant and doesn't know what to rely on, so you need to be careful. "
Although Ye Deyuan trusted his son's strength, the momentum Su Chen showed just now was too tyrannical, which made him feel a little uneasy.
"Brother, you are worrying too much!
Su Chen was born into a wealthy family and was once a young prodigy. He was only one step away from the Xuanwu realm. He had been tempered and baptized with many treasures since he was a child. It was normal for him to be stronger, but the damage to his bloodline talent and Dantian was irreversible! "
Ye Deming said.
"Father, don't worry!
His little reliance is nothing at all. Soon I will let him know that warriors are not just strong enough to compete! "
Ye Xinglong was quite confident and was not taken seriously by Su Chen at all.
Not only that, he also wanted to use this battle to completely clear his name and crush Su Chen to death so that he would never be able to stand up again!
In the square of the Ye Family Courtyard, the guests quickly retreated, leaving a huge open space.
Everyone's eyes were full of anticipation.
Ye Xinglong awakened his earth-level bloodline and was extremely talented. He successfully joined the Martial Arts Academy of the Royal Capital and was valued by the elders of the Martial Arts Academy and accepted him as a disciple!
Su Chen was once a young prodigy with heaven-level bloodline, and his cultivation reached the peak of the ninth level of the True Martial Realm. Although his talent and cultivation were all ruined, he showed amazing strength and must have a back-up plan.
These two are legendary figures in Beihuang City.
Whoosh!
Ye Xinglong's figure flashed and appeared in the center of the battle platform.
"Su Chen, you have the audacity to slander grandpa and my Ye family. Today I will teach you a lesson and let you know that a loser should live a submissive life. If you dare to be arrogant, you will only die!"
Ye Xinglong said coldly, his eyes full of viciousness.
"My abilities are not very good, but I talk a lot of nonsense!"
Su Chen sneered.
"You're looking for death!"
Ye Xinglong was immediately angered, and his eyes were filled with murderous intent.
boom!
The aura around him was surging, and the powerful Qi was raging like a storm. His cultivation at the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm exploded, causing fierce winds to blow throughout the Ye family compound.
"Hiss, ninth level of Qi Martial Realm? Ye Xinglong is only in his twenties this year, right?"
"To be exact, only twenty-one years old!"
"Reaching the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm at the age of twenty-one? This speed of cultivation is simply astonishing. It seems that Su Chen will definitely lose today!"
Everyone exclaimed in surprise.
In the vast Northern Wasteland City, even the older generation of warriors are still wandering around the Qi Martial Realm. His father, Ye Deyuan, had only just broken through to the True Martial Realm not long ago.
There is no doubt that Ye Xinglong's talent is top-notch even in the capital city where geniuses gather.
In their opinion, no matter how strong Su Chen was, he could only compete with a warrior at the fourth or fifth level of the Qi Martial Realm. How could he compete with Ye Xinglong, who was at the peak of the ninth level of the Qi Martial Realm?
